Players Committee card image of [[Tycho In Green Squadron 3]] (original printing), game text: “May deploy as a 'react'. Permanent pilot is •Tycho, who provides ability of 2 and adds 3 to his [Death Star 2] Epic Event destiny draws. During battle, may target a starfighter; target's immunity to attrition is canceled.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/tychoingreensquadron3.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
